Definition: from a compound of G2095 and G5590; to be in good spirits, i.e. feel encouraged:--be of good comfort.
BiblicalUsage: eupsychéō means be of good comfort. In Philippians 2:19, the text says "that I also may be of good comfort."
TheologicalSignificance: I take eupsychéō as it stands: be of good comfort.
